Generate uniform Stats input UI

Source: R/uniform_ui_inputs.R
uniform_stats_inputs_ui.Rd

Creates a standardized tagList of statistical testing inputs for use across plot modules that support pairwise comparisons (BoxPlot, yPlot, freqPlot).

Usage

uniform_stats_inputs_ui(ns, defaults = NULL)

Arguments

ns

A namespace function, typically created by NS(id).

defaults

A named list of default values for the inputs.

Value

A tagList containing the stats input UI elements.

See also

reset_stats_inputs(), default_stat_pairs(), stat_bracket_headroom(), create_stat_annotations(), apply_stat_annotations()

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

uniform_stats_inputs_ui(shiny::NS("stats"))
